findings.text: blocking: the log is a later re-run that failed at the first arm ('/bin/bash: line 1: UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/home/ITER/mcintos/Code/imas-codex/.venv: No such file or directory') because the env prefixes were stored in a variable and expanded into command position, the fixture arm stops at 'Starting temp Neo4j instance...', and the process was killed (exit 137) with no EXIT= line; the successful live/fixture/render runs exist only in the worker's stream, so the manifest's test_logs cannot show the done_when was measured.

non-blocking: validate() never checks that a rebind target is one of the row's recorded_paths, so a rebind to an independent DD path passes the guard the module docstring says refuses a proposal breaking its own rule; ratio_of_diamagnetic_vorticity_to_major_radius names only dd:edge_profiles/ggd/vorticity_over_r/diamagnetic in its target while its reason requires both recorded paths.

non-blocking: run_fixture writes the control result and main() at :656 only prints its four booleans, so the planted control is displayed rather than enforced - a predicate that failed to list the planted name would still deliver EXIT=0 and only a human reading the page would notice.

non-blocking: render() prints the literal 'live' when dd.lifecycle_status is null, so the page's claim that each recorded DD path is live rests on an absent property; all four recorded paths in scc-sourceless-names.json carry lifecycle_status null, and the code cannot distinguish a live node from one whose status was never set.

non-blocking: the census paragraph accounts for 11 of the 18 classified names (5 live, 4 exhausted, 1 derived parent, 1 unchained_holder) and never names the 7 held_in_chain names, so a reader cannot reconcile census_total=18 from the page or confirm that no live name was left out of the population.
